title: Breathing In Labour
summary: A distraction-free breathing app for labor preparation
content: Breathing In Labour: A distraction-free breathing app for labor preparation | Product Hunt Launching today Breathing In Labour Launching today A distraction-free breathing app for labor preparation 163 followers A distraction-free breathing app for labor preparation 163 followers Visit website Health & Fitness • Meditation apps Breathing In Labour is an educational, distraction-free alternative to cluttered and ad-heavy labor prep apps. It stands out by offering: 1. Built-in knowledge of proven breathing techniques for all stages of labor. 2. A hyper-minimalist interface with calming visual feedback to master breathing rhythms. 3. Zero ads or forced accounts to get in the way of your practice. 4. Core mechanics are 100% free to use. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Forum Team More Free Launch tags: Health & Fitness • Parenting • Education 3-day free Premium trial Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 8 Day Rank Upvote • 126 points Follow Breathing In Labour Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info lebene.pl/en/app/breathing-in-labour App Store Play Store Breathing In Labour Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/breathing-in-labour Similar Products Soula Care AI-powered assistant for pregnancy, birth and postpartum 4.9 ( 14 reviews ) AI Chatbots Pregnancy apps Breezz - Breathing and Meditation (iOS) Take a deep breath and relax with Breezz 5.0 ( 1 review ) Meditation apps Othership Guided breathwork to shift your state 4.5 ( 4 reviews ) Sleep apps Meditation apps Vagus+ Improve your mental and physical well-being 5.0 ( 1 review ) Health & Fitness Meditation apps Olo - Easier than Meditation Achieve more by rewiring your nervous system with sound 5.0 ( 4 reviews ) Sleep apps Meditation apps View more Subscribe Sign in Forum Threads p/breathing-in-labour Artur Jankowski • 16h ago Do you ever consciously practice breathing? I realized most of us breathe all day without ever thinking about it. Do any of you intentionally practice breathing whether during workouts, meditation, yoga, before sleep, or just to calm down after a stressful day? Has it made any noticeable difference for you? 1 3 View all Social Instagram Viktor.com An AI coworker that actually does the work Try Viktor.com Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Artur Jankowski Breathing In Labour Maker 📌 Hi Product Hunt! 👋 I'm Artur, maker of Breathing in Labour. This started when my partner and I were preparing for birth: breathing is the one tool every birth class teaches, but during a contraction nobody remembers "inhale 4, exhale 8." You need something to follow, not something to remember. So I built a breath coach you follow, not read — a calm animation paces every inhale, hold and exhale. It was born for labor, but the same techniques work for anyone: stress, anxious moments, falling asleep, box breathing at 3am with a newborn. If you breathe, it's for you. 🫁 The part I'm most proud of: everything you actually need is free. All 7 guided techniques

title: SoundPipe
summary: SoundPipe is a mixing board for your Mac
content: SoundPipe: SoundPipe is a mixing board for your Mac | Product Hunt Launching today SoundPipe Launching today SoundPipe is a mixing board for your Mac 5.0 • 1 review • 154 followers SoundPipe is a mixing board for your Mac 5.0 • 1 review • 154 followers Visit website SoundPipe creates virtual audio devices on your Mac so you can send audio from any app, or your microphone, to any other app. Overview Reviews 1 Alternatives Built with Team More Free Options Launch tags: Productivity • Apple • Audio 30% OFF Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 6 Day Rank Upvote • 138 points Follow SoundPipe Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info soundpipe.app SoundPipe Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/soundpipe Similar Products Loopback Cable-Free Audio Routing for MAC 5.0 ( 2 reviews ) eqMac System Audio Equalizer and Volume Mixer for macOS 4.9 ( 22 reviews ) Boom video Present live, record your screen, look pro on camera 5.0 ( 6 reviews ) Video conferencing Presentation Software Hand Mirror A one-click camera check, right from the menu bar 5.0 ( 5 reviews ) Camera apps Screenshots and screen recording apps Camo Great video made easy 4.6 ( 5 reviews ) Video editing Camera apps View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Chris Battarbee Metoro Maker 📌 Hi Product Hunt! I'm Chris, the maker of SoundPipe. I built this because routing audio on a Mac always felt harder than it should be. I just wanted to listen to my mac, my iPad and my linux machine at the same time through my AirPods. This just isn't possible natively. macOS still has no built-in way to send one app's sound into another: no record button for what your Mac is playing, no way to pipe app audio into a call. The classic answers are BlackHole, which is free but leaves you hand-wiring multi-output devices in Audio MIDI Setup, or Loopback, which is wonderful but costs $99. SoundPipe is my attempt at the middle: virtual audio devices with a UI where every route is a visible wire, live meters on every channel, per-channel volume, and monitoring built in. The driver installs with one click (no terminal, no kernel extensions) and the whole path runs under 15 ms of latency at any sample rate your devices support. Pricing is super simple: $10 once, use it on up to 3 Macs, no subscription, no account. The trial is the full app in 20-minute sessions that you can restart forever, so you can be sure it works with your setup before paying. I'd genuinely love feedback, especially on use cases I haven't covered: streaming setups, DAW workflows, weird hardware. I'll be here all day answering questions. PS: for launch day (+ day after) it's $7 instead of $10 with the code PRODUCTHUNT at checkout.
